visualReview.notes: Inspected52 current source/shared/medium-fi/native views during one continuous author/build/inspect/fix pass. Changed the initial square chimney lids to shallow faceted hoods and moved the exterior camera clear of the independent map colonnade. The close fountain view caught an overlapping brace/window bay: removed those intersections, lowered the arch below the upper projection and corrected/deepened the bowl inner profile so its recess reads clearly. The model retains the external court and opens the reconstructed head court through every roof. Lowered the fountain foot0.08m to meet retained court ground. Inspected nine changed final frames;43 frames retain prior actual inspection with byte-identical PNGs. All eleven prior palace assets retain exact input/source/runtime hashes; Hasoda remains an inactive terrain-fit draft.
